units.en: The ⟦0⟧ (or ⟦1⟧ for short) is a ⟦2⟧ in Central Europe with a population of ⟦3⟧. Germany has a rapidly growing military industry and army and is surrounded by countries which soon may find themselves conquered. It borders ⟦4⟧ to the north, ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ to the east, and ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧ to the south. To the west lies ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ and the ⟦12⟧.

Germany is in many ways "the star of the show" in Hearts of Iron IV, with both historical and technical precedence, as it acts as the primary driving force of many early-game events in historical playthroughs and is also usually the instigator of World War II, with many of the in-game events and focus trees tailored to bring about a conflict roughly comparable to the real-life counterpart. That being said, the player can freely change the course of events and either change the course of Germany's path or steal the spotlight as another country.

After the collapse of the German Empire in the November Revolution of 1918/19 after WW1 the Weimar Republic was proclaimed, named after the German city where its constitutional convention was held. The troubled Weimar Republic would exist until 1933 when the NSDAP seized power and transformed the country into a fascist dictatorship led by ⟦0⟧. By 1936 the NSDAP had cemented its power, having purged most of the opposition, and thus could focus on preparing for the next war.

Germany was the primary ⟦0⟧ in the European Theatre. Historically, the German Reich precipitated the Second World War by attacking Poland on 1 September 1939, and would go on to establish a brief but notorious hegemony over continental Europe after conquering France in 20 June 1940. The German Reich will later go on to invade the Soviet Union in 22 June 1941. The German Reich closed down the European Theatre of the Second World War through its surrender and fall between 4 May and 9 May 1945.

⟦0⟧, as one of the seven major powers, has a unique national focus tree.
The German national focus tree can be divided into 7 branches, 25 Sub-branches and 1 branch with 3 sub-branches if the DLC ⟦0⟧ is disabled:
This builds on Germany's ground force and modifies the ⟦0⟧ national modifier.
This builds on Germany's airforce and modifies the ⟦0⟧ national modifier.
This builds on Germany's navy and modifies the ⟦0⟧ national modifier.
This branch focuses on slowly rebuilding Germany's economy and ultimately creating an economic miracle.
Construct the Reichsautobahn Sub-branch This shared sub-branch builds Infrastructure and Railways throughout Germany and neighboring areas.
This shared sub-branch builds ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ throughout Germany and neighboring areas.

This branch prioritizes on making Germany self sufficient and unlocks a special trade law, ⟦0⟧. It may improve the trade law after building and obtaining more resources. It can also get special economy law called after building up the country's military industry.

The historical branch at first, remilitarizes the Rhineland, against the stipulations of the Treaty of Versailles. The player may decide to listen to Konstantin von Neurath and take a more cautious approach. This allows the peaceful integration and coring of ⟦0⟧. The player may instead follow Joachim von Ribbentrop with an aggressive stance and befriend the ⟦1⟧. It may also give Germany the decisions to make ⟦2⟧ and build the SS divisions.

This gives bonuses to the nation's intelligence agency. It also gives special operatives, including Coco Chanel, if Germany controls Ile de France (16) It is only available with the La Résistance DLC enabled.

These focuses build the Führer's inner circle. It represents the infighting between the Führer's closest advisors. When the player completes an advisor's beginning focus, they will start completing the below focuses themselves which will give bonuses depending on the advisor. Then 3 of them will ascend as Reichsleiters and may be able to usurp Hitler's position, or stay loyal to him.
This sub-branch hires and gives bonuses to army leaders and gives Germany penal divisions.
This sub-branch gives Germany expansion opportunities throughout Europe.
Demonstration of Military Achievements Sub-branch If Germany keeps expanding by either occupying states, gaining subjects, or capitulating major powers, its leader will gain beneficial traits.
Demand Slovenia Sub-branch This gives Germany expansion opportunities into the Balkan region.

Operation Sea Lion Sub-branch This gives bonuses to naval invasion, with expansion to the British Isles and into the Americas. It will also give Germany the decision to make Reichskommissariats in the Americas.

Anti-Comintern Pact Sub-branch This sub-branch focuses on expansion into eastern Europe, Asia and Africa. Germany may decide to help either the Chinese or the Japanese in the Sino-Japanese war. It will also give Germany the decision to make Reichskommissariats in Asia and Africa.
This focus shared between the historical and opposition branches, give Germany to volunteers sent to the Spanish Civil War.
The following branches are only available with the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
The opposition branch triggers a civil war against the ⟦0⟧ in order to change the course of the country.

This sub-branch prepares a civil war in order to convert Germany into a Communist ideology. The left side focuses on the country's intelligence agency, while the right side focuses on the country's military.

Legacy of the Spartacus League Sub-branch This makes the Spartacists the ruling Communist faction, gets the Politbüro national spirit and spreads Communism to other countries to influence them to become German volkskommissariats
Intervene in Spain/Assist Our Eastern Comrades Sub-branch These focuses allows Germany to assist in either the Spanish Civil War or the War in China.
Liberate Austria Sub-branch This shared section sparks Communist revolutions around Europe with expansion to the Americas and Asia.
Nationalize Industries Sub-branch This shared section builds industry in the country.
Proletarian Dictatorship Sub-branch This gives war goals against other European countries, instead of the volkskommissariat system.
Sign the Second Treaty of Berlin Sub-branch This allies with the Soviet Union and divides Europe and creates spheres of influence.

This sub-branch restores Germany's monarchy under Wilhelm II and rebuilds Germany after the Civil war. The player may instead have the Kaiser as a figure head as a military high command leads the country.

Re-establish Free Elections Sub-branch Instead, the player may form a constitutional monarchy with Wilhelm III in the throne. It may ally with France and gain war goals against remaining Fascist nations in Europe.
Realpolitik Sub-branch The focuses under this sub-branch emphasize on expanding within the European continent.
Mitteleuropa Sub-branch This section seeks to rebuild the Central Powers and builds the groundwork to a European Federation.

Restore the Holy Roman Empire Sub-branch This hidden focus creates the Holy Roman Empire if Kaiserin Victoria is in power or if Germany decides to conquer Italy via focus. It will also replace the Reichstag building with the Volkshalle and gives a national spirit.

See to the Eastern Front/Restore the Brest-Litovsk Borders Sub-branch These set Germany's expansion route towards Eastern Europe. Either by allying with the Poles and other oppressed peoples against the Soviet Union or carve up Eastern Europe under the plans of the Brest-Litovsk treaty.
Reject the Locarno Treaty Sub-branch These focuses sets Germany's expansion towards France and Western Europe.

Weltpolitik Sub-branch These focuses set Germany's route of expansion outside of Europe by either allying the United Kingdom to expand around the world while negotiating with them, making enemies out of them in order to destroy the old colonial hegemony, or entering a friendship with China to make spheres of influence in Asia.
The following branches are only available without the ⟦0⟧ DLC:
This branch allows ⟦0⟧ to remove Adolf Hitler and the NSDAP from power via civil war and restore the German Monarchy to pursue a ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧.

This sub-branch restores Germany's monarchy under Wilhelm II, re-creating the German Empire that fell in 1918 and gives war goals against the British and the French, and allows for restoring the Italian and Austro-Hungarian monarchies; Germany can also choose to be subordinate to the British and ally them while fighting against communist France. It also allies with eastern nations in order to crush the communist threat of the Soviet Union in the east.
This shared monarchist and Democratic sub-branch rebuilds Germany after the civil war with industry and manpower bonuses.

This sub-branch creates a constitutional monarchy; it can happen under both Kaisers Wilhelm II and Wilhelm III. It creates a faction with Austria, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Yugoslavia, Romania, Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, and Finland in order to crush the Soviet Union and other communist factions (like France and any other country that turns communist through its focus tree). It also adds one more research slot than the regular five slots and gives boosts to nuclear technology.
